title: Map Viewer: Complete Chunk 3/4 parser for texture data
description: Complete parsing of Chunks 3 & 4 from .map files. Parse 255 tile definitions (14 bytes each) and 63 texture IDs. Switch viewer to use ChunkMapLoader for authentic game textures.

title: Data validation engine implementation
description: Implement comprehensive validation system from C# reference. Includes: validation rules, cross-category dependency checking, balance validation for spells/creatures, validation reports. Estimated 2-3 weeks.

title: Map Viewer: Implement multi-layer texture blending
description: Implement SpellForce's 3-layer terrain texture blending system. Infrastructure exists (multi_layer_texture_system.py). Start with procedural height/slope-based blending, then add chunk parser for authentic game data.

title: Create tutorial mod: Hello World quest
description: Create basic quest mod tutorial using Quest Creator System. First example mod for community learning.

title: Animation system implementation
description: Implement animation preview following C# patterns. Parse animation data from game files, create animation preview widget, add editor capabilities, integrate with NPC/creature creators. Estimated 2-3 weeks.

title: ITM icon extraction quality improvements
description: Fix minor alignment/offset issues in ITM extraction script affecting visual quality. Address after icon mapping is resolved.

title: Resolve icon handle-to-atlas mapping (CRITICAL BLOCKER)
description: GameData exports contain item_ui_handle and item_ui_index but no item_ui_texture field. Must reverse-engineer game logic or find mapping data to link items to their atlas files. Blocks icon system completion.

title: In-game testing of Weapon Forge exports
description: Test exported weapons from Weapon Forge in actual SpellForce game. Verify CFF exports work correctly and weapons appear/function as expected.

title: Create visual asset browser/catalog
description: Build interactive asset browser for 59,500+ extracted assets. Include search, preview, categorization. Planned for Q1 2026.

title: Lua script integration for quest/spell systems
description: Add Lua script parsing following C# implementation. Includes: quest dependency parsing, spell effect script integration, Lua editor with validation. Estimated 3-4 weeks.

title: GUI Editor: Implement advanced features (Phase 5)
description: Implement Phase 5 features: undo/redo, add/clone/delete elements, global search, batch edit operations, CSV export/import.

title: Advanced game logic editor
description: Create specialized editors for complex game systems. Includes: campaign flow editor, balance parameter editor, difficulty scaling editor, multiplayer settings editor. Estimated 4-6 weeks.

title: Implement engine-core architecture separation
description: Following C# spellforce_data_editor patterns: Create separate engine/core module for game logic. Includes: engine/game_data, engine/parsers, engine/validators, engine/models. Estimated 3-4 weeks.

title: 3D model integration (MSB/MSH loading)
description: Implement MSB/MSH model loading from C# reference. Add 3D preview widget for weapons/armor, model exporter, and integration with content creators. Estimated 3-4 weeks.

title: Spell icon GUI integration testing
description: Verify that the fixed _resolve_icon_path method correctly displays spell icons in GUI editor. Test with known spell handles and verify 4x4 atlas grid structure.

title: Building Creator System research and implementation
description: Research and implement Construction Kit for custom structures. Currently marked as RESEARCH NEEDED in planning docs. Design wizard-style interface similar to other creators.

title: Mod management system
description: Create mod packaging and dependency management. Implement mod package format, dependency tracking/resolution, installation/uninstallation tools, compatibility checking. Estimated 3-4 weeks.

title: Enhance CFF parser with C# patterns
description: Upgrade Python CFF parser based on C# binary reading patterns. Implement robust binary parsing with category-specific handling and improved error handling.
